//: Capability manifest for text/1 — keen-pure-admin. See label.map.json for the variant model + button.map.json for the channel:rest convention. text/1 renders a bare inline <span> carrying a `.text-{variant}` colour utility (primary|success|danger|warning|info), an optional `title` tooltip (via the :global :rest map), a class passthrough, and the inner_block slot. No variant → class-less <span>.
